fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-sourced cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Hasbro’s official instructions page https://instructions.hasbro.com/es-cl/instruction/operation-silly-skill-game identifies item 40198 and displays this English-text 2008 Funatomy sound-effects box. The cited English rules at https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/40198.pdf describe the same 13 Funatomy parts and electronic game. Reduced to 360 × 252 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The youngest "doctor" goes first. Play then passes to the left.
clarifications: This edition has two skill levels set by a switch on the board: Level 1 for younger players, and Level 2 (which buzzes immediately on touching the metal side of a cavity) for older or more experienced players.
The game ends when all 13 Funatomy parts have been collected; whoever collected the most wins.
internalEvidence: Fetched the official Hasbro-hosted PDF directly and extracted its text with pdftotext. "How to Play, The youngest ‘doctor’ goes first. Play then passes to the left." The document is confirmed as item 40198, the electronic Funatomy-parts edition of Operation, by its parts chart (Bird Brained, Runny Nose, Ringing in the Ear, etc.) and battery/FCC compliance sections.
uncertainty: This is the specific electronic Funatomy-parts edition (item 40198); other Operation editions may phrase or handle the starting-player rule differently.
